crossRefs.note: He said to his men, “Yahweh forbid that I should do this thing to my lord, Yahweh’s anointed, to stretch out my hand…
So David checked his men with these words, and didn’t allow them to rise against Saul. Saul rose up out of the cave…
David said to him, “Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy Yahweh’s anointed?”
David said to him, “Your blood be on your head; for your mouth has testified against you, saying, ‘I have slain…
“Don’t touch my anointed ones! Do my prophets no harm!”

people.name: Abishai
people.line: David's nephew, one of his mighty men and commanders

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: David said to Abishai, “Don’t destroy him; for who can stretch out his hand against Yahweh’s anointed, and be guiltless?”
translations.bsb: But David said to Abishai, “Do not destroy him, for who can extend a hand against the LORD’s anointed and be guiltless?”
translations.kjv: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not: for who can stretch forth his hand against the LORD'S anointed, and be guiltless?
translations.asv: And David said to Abishai, Destroy him not; for who can put forth his hand against Jehovah's anointed, and be guiltless?
